editorial:
Imagine being in a giant underground parking lot in France and realizing you have no idea where you left your car. Now, imagine your pregnant girlfriend is right there with you and she starts going into labor. That is the nightmare you get with this wild comedy. You will follow a guy who is definitely not the smartest person in the room as he panics and wanders through endless rows of concrete and cars. The vibe is basically a race against time where everything that can go wrong absolutely does, making you laugh at how bad his luck is.

The pacing is quick and the acting makes the panic feel real, even when the situations are totally ridiculous. While the plot is simple, the tension keeps you hooked because you just want the baby to be born safely. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: After a long and stressful search, the main character finally finds his car just in time. In a funny and chaotic final scene, the baby is born right there in the parking garage. The stress of the situation finally breaks him, but everything turns out okay. He learns a big lesson about being more organized, and the movie ends with a sweet moment between the new parents and their newborn baby.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slapstick humor and high-stress comedy.
